## Quality Guardrails (mrd rubric)

Self-evaluate against every category below before reporting done; revise until the pass criteria hold.

- [ ] **Problem Statement** (required, blocking): Clarity and relevance of the market problem being addressed
  - Problem is clearly articulated with quantified impact, timing justification, and cost of inaction
- [ ] **Customer Segments (BMC)** (required): Definition of target customer segments with needs and sizing
  - Segments defined with TAM/SAM/SOM, needs, pain points, and buyer personas
- [ ] **Value Propositions (BMC)** (required): Clarity of value delivered to each customer segment
  - Pain relievers and gain creators mapped to specific segments with differentiation
- [ ] **Competitive Analysis** (required): Understanding of competitive landscape and differentiation
  - Comprehensive analysis of direct/indirect competitors with clear differentiation strategy
- [ ] **Channels & Relationships (BMC)** (required): How we reach customers and relationship strategy
  - All 5 channel phases covered with appropriate relationship types per segment
- [ ] **Revenue Streams (BMC)** (required): Viability and clarity of revenue model
  - Revenue types, pricing tiers, and projections clearly defined
- [ ] **Resources & Activities (BMC)** (required): Key resources and activities required
  - Critical resources and core activities identified with clear rationale
- [ ] **Partnerships & Costs (BMC)** (required): Partnership strategy and cost structure
  - Key partnerships with motivations identified; cost structure analyzed
- [ ] **Market Requirements** (required, blocking): Clarity and prioritization of market requirements
  - Requirements prioritized (MoSCoW), traceable to segments, and well-rationalized
- [ ] **Business Alignment & OKRs** (required, blocking): Alignment with business goals and measurable success metrics
  - Clear OKRs with strategic alignment and quantified success metrics
- [ ] **Risk Assessment** (required): Identification of constraints, assumptions, and risks
  - Risk matrix with impact, probability, and mitigation; assumptions validated

Overall pass: every required category passes; findings allowed: 0 critical, 1 high, 2 medium, unlimited low
